pokedexEntries.rb: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

pokedexEntries.ye: Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.

pokedexEntries.go: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

pokedexEntries.si: It loves to work out and build its muscles. It is never satisfied, even if it trains hard all day long.

pokedexEntries.cr: It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.

pokedexEntries.ru: MACHOP’s muscles are special - they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This POKéMON has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.

pokedexEntries.sa: MACHOP exercises by hefting around a GRAVELER as if it were a barbell. There are some MACHOP that travel the world in a quest to master all kinds of martial arts.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

pokedexEntries.lg: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

pokedexEntries.em: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.

pokedexEntries.di: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its muscles never cramp however much it trains. It lives in the mountains away from humans.

pokedexEntries.pt: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of GEODUDE at once.

pokedexEntries.su: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

pokedexEntries.mo: With its superhuman strength, it’s able to throw a hundred people all at the same time. Its strength comes from lifting Graveler every day.

pokedexEntries.us: Once this Pokémon has gained enough confidence and muscle from training with its friends, it challenges Makuhita to a battle.

pokedexEntries.um: It likes food that’s highly nutritious because its instincts drive it to build muscle efficiently.
